status: Qualitative research slate only; no assigned lane and no implementation or geological experiment in this session.
novelty_limit: The cited G28 reviews describe these specific operators as untried at their dates; the complete current parallel registry is absent, so present-day exclusivity or global novelty is unverified.

hypotheses.name: Displaced potential-field piercing markers
hypotheses.layers: Reduced-to-pole / total magnetic intensity and gravity; candidate corridor across multiple marker ridges.
hypotheses.mechanism: A concealed fault could displace pre-existing magnetic or density contacts; look for a consistent repeated lateral offset, not the contact itself.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Intrusive or branching lithologic contacts and acquisition/registration seams.
hypotheses.prior_work_difference: Paired cross-corridor displacement rather than an ordinary edge or scalar gradient; earlier G28 slate ranked it unimplemented.
hypotheses.expected_improvement: Unknown, no score or quantitative projection; highest qualitative information potential in this slate.
hypotheses.cost_and_gates: Medium-high; requires verified reusable template cache, signal and alignment checks, feature canaries and complete registry. Raw owner mirrors exist but cache is absent.

hypotheses.name: Lithology-conditioned U/Th transport dipoles
hypotheses.layers: GeoDAWN uranium, thorium and potassium radiometrics; signed cross-corridor residual conditioned on local lithology.
hypotheses.mechanism: Fluid/redox transport could create an asymmetric geochemical signature near a permeable structure, even without a visible scarp.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Groundwater redox fronts, sediment sorting, lithologic contacts, radon disequilibrium and survey seams.
hypotheses.prior_work_difference: Ordered paired residual rather than a scalar ratio or lineament; earlier G28 slate described this exact operator as untried.
hypotheses.expected_improvement: Unknown and physically ambiguous; no DTI projection.
hypotheses.cost_and_gates: Medium; verify radiometric units, quantization, coverage, source alignment and missingness before any trial.

hypotheses.name: Paired-geothermometer cooling corridors
hypotheses.layers: Quality-filtered, spatially deduplicated well/spring temperatures and paired geothermometers from INGENIOUS.
hypotheses.mechanism: Directional multi-site thermal/geochemical contrasts might trace a permeable fault-controlled discharge corridor; they are not direct fault labels.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Groundwater mixing, geothermometer disequilibrium, drilling effects and preferential sampling.
hypotheses.prior_work_difference: Paired directional contrasts rather than maximum-temperature buffers; earlier G28 slate described this exact operator as untried.
hypotheses.expected_improvement: Unknown, constrained by sparse and biased observations; no DTI projection.
hypotheses.cost_and_gates: Medium; hash-pinned owner-mirror CSV restored for tests, but raw source package, coverage, duplicate sites, sample quality and competition shareability still require verification; avoid any catalogue-derived leakage.

protocol: Select only the assigned lane, run feature-alone canaries and surface novelty first, then a frozen buffered whole-segment shared holdout with visible-only catalogue features. Check final dots, exact bytes and separate slot selector.
